scope: Screened all 752 noun and 197 adjective cards for displayed-form coverage, frozen headword metadata, reported omissions and lookup behavior. Targeted source comparison of flagged candidates; not an independent dictionary verification of every sense. Covers ordinary gender/number forms and the three attested adjective apocopations; excludes systematic diminutives, superlatives, regional spelling variants and unrelated lexical counterparts.

retained.fútbol: This card teaches the sport, normally used without a plural. Plural uses for varieties of football are outside this sense.
retained.pasado: This card teaches the past as a general time or idea, normally singular. Other countable uses are not included here.
retained.izquierda: The taught expression a mi izquierda is singular. Plural izquierdas also occurs in politics and fixed directional expressions such as a izquierdas (counterclockwise); it is not categorically invalid.
retained.música: This card teaches music as a general idea. Músicas can describe kinds of music or female musicians in other uses.
